art.logging_limit: The blocking kmsg reader did not deliver later trace output; reopening it after a 10-second delay captured the ART syscall tail. UART diagnostic emitted no syscall records. Logging behavior requires separate investigation.
art.note: The initial ordinary run attached the properties START marker to an unterminated firmware line. The launcher now prefixes bootstrap START records with a newline; subsequent diagnostic runs show a complete bootstrap sequence.
art.next_blocker: A diagnostic snapshot 10 seconds after ART start ends in AArch64 syscall 98, FUTEX_WAIT_PRIVATE (0x80), expected value 3, no timeout. The ART mutex owner and originating failure remain undetermined.

diagnostic.instrumentation: Temporary Android syscall tracing, delayed native kmsg snapshot, and an LD_PRELOAD library calling Android public __android_log_set_logger. Diagnostic changes are preserved as artifacts only, not present in the production kernel/launcher.
